sources.entry: Vuvuzela - FIFA World Cup 2026 desktop widget with live scores, group standings, and the knockout bracket.

summary.one_liner: Vuvuzela is a lightweight macOS desktop widget showing live FIFA World Cup 2026 scores, group standings, match schedule, and the knockout bracket.
summary.what_it_does: The widget sits on the desktop as a borderless window above the wallpaper and below app windows. It shows all 12 group tables with rank, flag, P/W/D/L/GD/Pts, and colors qualifying positions (top 2 and best-third projection) using FIFA tiebreakers. During live group matches, in-progress scores are projected onto the standings. The matches view has LIVE, Upcoming (grouped by day, local timezone), and Results sections, and a bracket view covers the knockout tree from Round of 32 to the Final. Users can star teams as favourites, which enables macOS notifications for goals and kick-offs, and the widget supports drag-to-move, resizing, a position lock, and four opacity levels. Polling frequency adapts to whether a match is in progress or imminent, and pauses when the widget is hidden.
use_cases: track World Cup 2026 live scores on the desktop
check group standings and qualification status
view the knockout bracket as results come in
get goal and kick-off alerts for a favourite team
see the full World Cup match schedule in local time
how_to_run: git clone <repository URL> (URL not given in README)
notable: Desktop-level borderless widget that stays behind app windows
Best-third qualification projection using FIFA tiebreakers
Live standings projection from in-progress match scores
Favourite-team notifications for goals and kick-offs
Adaptive polling that pauses when the widget is hidden
caveats: Building from source needs a Swift 6 toolchain (Command Line Tools suffice)
Notifications only fire for teams explicitly starred as favourites
